component.name: Xenia Canary Config Tool
Xenia Canary 配置工具
component.summary: 图形化编辑 xenia-canary.config.toml 配置文件

description.p: Xenia Canary Config Tool provides a graphical interface for every setting in xenia-canary.config.toml. All 265 options across 22 sections are available, organised into categories with their original documentation.

Built for Linux handhelds: it runs natively under Wayland (including the gamescope compositor used by SteamOS game mode) and scales from 1280x800 displays upward. The interface is available in Simplified Chinese and English, switchable at runtime.

ul.li: Browse every setting by category, with search across names and descriptions
Type-aware editors: toggles for booleans, drop-downs for enumerated values, numeric fields with range hints
Hover any row to read its full documentation without leaving the list
Pick any xenia-canary.config.toml location; saving writes back in place
Automatic timestamped backup before every write
Preserves your file's comments, ordering and formatting

description.p: Xenia Canary 配置工具为 xenia-canary.config.toml 中的每一项设置提供图形界面。 22 个分组、共 265 项配置全部可用，并按分类组织，同时保留官方原始说明。
面向 Linux 掌机设计：在 Wayland（含 SteamOS 游戏模式使用的 gamescope 合成器）下原生运行， 1280x800 及更高分辨率均可自适应。界面支持简体中文与英文，可运行时实时切换。

ul.li: 按分类浏览全部设置，支持按名称与说明搜索
按类型智能编辑：布尔值用开关、枚举值用下拉框、数值项带范围提示
鼠标悬停即显示完整说明，不必离开列表
可自选 xenia-canary.config.toml 位置，保存时默认写回原文件
每次写入前自动生成带时间戳的备份
保留原文件的注释、顺序与排版格式

description.p: Initial release: full coverage of all 265 settings in 22 sections, category navigation, hover documentation, bilingual interface, and automatic backups.
首个版本：完整覆盖 22 个分组共 265 项设置，分类导航、悬停说明、中英双语界面与自动备份。
